1.name: TEXT_REGISB5TERTIUM_00753_SYSTEM_100_000
1.description: He clearly has no intention of speaking with you.

2.name: TEXT_REGISB5TERTIUM_00753_DECIMUS_000_001
2.description: I know who you are. <hex:022903EB0203>, champion of Eorzea, yes? Our orders are to give you the run of our encampment, but I have my eye on you. So, what business do you have with me?

3.name: TEXT_REGISB5TERTIUM_00753_DECIMUS_000_002
3.description: Lord Quintus was our rock in the storm...and now, we are without a leader, without direction. Nevertheless, we must live on, even if that means consorting with our former enemies. Well, what do you want?

4.name: TEXT_REGISB5TERTIUM_00753_DECIMUS_000_003
4.description: The end has come, and we are powerless to resist. Are you here to bear witness to Garlemald's demise, or is there some other reason?

5.name: TEXT_REGISB5TERTIUM_00753_DECIMUS_000_004
5.description: The Final Days your comrades speak of have been averted, and we yet live. Even now, the words of Lord Quintus serve as our inspiration, as we march into a new era. But tell me, is there aught you wish to know?

8.name: TEXT_REGISB5TERTIUM_00753_A1_000_002
8.description: What kind of place is this?

10.name: TEXT_REGISB5TERTIUM_00753_DECIMUS_000_100
10.description: I am Decimus, centurion of the Ist Legion. It is my sworn duty to defend Garlemald from barbarians such as you, and your very presence here is an affront to my honor.

11.name: TEXT_REGISB5TERTIUM_00753_DECIMUS_000_101
11.description: I am Decimus, centurion of the Ist Legion. Although my legatus is no more, I will continue to defend this last bastion and those who seek refuge here.

12.name: TEXT_REGISB5TERTIUM_00753_DECIMUS_000_102
12.description: I am Decimus, centurion of the Ist Legion. Or at least, I was. With the Empire fallen and our glorious capital in ruins, what meaning have such appellations? Even so, I remain a Garlean and I require neither rank nor station to defend my people.

13.name: TEXT_REGISB5TERTIUM_00753_DECIMUS_000_200
13.description: This is Tertium, third among the stations that encircle the city. The decommissioned carriages here now serve as the Ist Legion's temporary base of operations.

14.name: TEXT_REGISB5TERTIUM_00753_DECIMUS_000_201
14.description: It has also become a safe haven for those fleeing the turmoil that has befallen the capital. What scant supplies we have are distributed among civilian and soldier alike, and we strive to maintain some semblance of order in these dark times.

15.name: TEXT_REGISB5TERTIUM_00753_DECIMUS_000_202
15.description: Our true objective, however, is not merely to survive, but to reclaim our home. We have no time to deal with your band of savages, and if you dare to interfere in our affairs, we will not hesitate to cut you down.

16.name: TEXT_REGISB5TERTIUM_00753_DECIMUS_000_203
16.description: Our dream of taking back the city lies in tatters, but we shall fight on until the bitter end. I only hope that those who have fled will fare better than I and my men.

17.name: TEXT_REGISB5TERTIUM_00753_DECIMUS_000_204
17.description: While we may have been spared the cataclysm, our struggle continues. With the words of Lord Quintus to guide us, we will rebuild and start anew.

18.name: TEXT_REGISB5TERTIUM_00753_DECIMUS_000_205
18.description: For affording us this second chance, you have my sincerest gratitude.

19.name: TEXT_REGISB5TERTIUM_00753_DECIMUS_000_206
19.description: But now it seems we may soon have a horde of voidsent arriving at our doorstep. Even so, we need no armies to honor the words of Lord Quintus. We <hex:021A020203>will<hex:021A020103> weather this storm, just as we have so many others.

20.name: TEXT_REGISB5TERTIUM_00753_DECIMUS_000_207
20.description: A task, I will admit, we may not have accomplished without the aid of you and yours. First the cataclysm, and now this recent threat of voidsent. On behalf of my brethren, I offer you my sincerest thanks.

21.name: TEXT_REGISB5TERTIUM_00753_DECIMUS_000_208
21.description: Yet with the forging of this trade agreement with Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han, our supply woes may very well come to an end. For the first time in a long while, I am hopeful for the future.

22.name: TEXT_REGISB5TERTIUM_00753_DECIMUS_000_209
22.description: Though I stand here now as a member of the Garlean community, the words of Lord Quintus still provide strength. My brethren and I <hex:021A020203>will<hex:021A020103> survive─we <hex:021A020203>will<hex:021A020103> prevail.
